description_en: Queries the status of IP addresses of points of presence (POPs). The status of an IP address of a POP indicates whether content delivery acceleration is supported by the POP
description_zh: 调用DescribeIpStatus查询节点IP可用状态，进而根据节点IP可用状态来了解节点加速服务的可用状态
name: DescribeIpStatus

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses that you want to query. Separate IP addresses with underscores (_), such as Ips=ip1_ip2
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的IP地址列表，最多支持批量查询20个IP地址，IP地址之间使用下划线_分隔，如：ip1_ip2_ip3
parameters.name: ips

IpStatus.description_en: The status of the IP addresses of the POPs

ip.description_en: The IP address of the POP

status.description_en:
The status.

nonali: not an Alibaba Cloud CDN POP

normal: an available Alibaba Cloud CDN POP

abnormal: an unavailable Alibaba Cloud CDN POP
status.description_zh:
状态。

nonali：非阿里云CDN节点。
normal：阿里云CDN节点，正常状态。
abnormal：阿里云CDN节点，异常状态
